title: Retry usage replaces previously incurred cost and tokens
reasoning: Each invocation starts fresh cost and token totals, but synchronization assigns those totals to the agent's accumulated usage. Calling retry therefore discards the preceding invocation's cost and tokens while retaining its incrementally accumulated steps. This underreports consumption and can allow combined run-and-retry usage to exceed configured limits without detection.
reproduction: Have an initial invocation and its retry each report a cost below the configured limit, with their combined cost above it. After retry, usage.cost contains only the retry cost.
recommendation: Accumulate invocation cost and net tokens across retries, while maintaining current_tokens according to its intended per-invocation contract.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included; the supplied evidence does not demonstrate coverage of accounting across multiple invocations.
suggestedRegressionTest: Exercise a run followed by multiple retries with distinct usage totals; verify cumulative cost, net tokens, steps, and enforcement when combined consumption crosses a limit.
